gray_areas.explanation: Lineage retention and rejection wording are less explicit than in R17/R08. I credit a specified second sensor measuring a distinct feature, timestamped observations, and joint-dependence estimation as minimal provenance; the held-out incremental-prediction and net-cost executable-value test supplies a meaningful failure condition. I do not require the literal words lineage or reject. A fully explicit provenance log and rejection rule would be preferable but the substantive test is present.

summary: R17, R42, R08 and R63 each score 24/24; no rubric critical errors found. All numerical cases and required decisions match independent recomputation. R42/R63 receive E01 item 4 credit on a semantic reading of source-specific prospective observations and a held-out incremental-value test; the provenance/falsifier gray area is documented. The six cases support no profit or causal prompt-effect claim.
